title: Harp's Hideaway | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Pet Friendly condo complete with coastal chic decor, a large community pool, and a 4-minute walk to the private beach- Harp's Hideaway by Royal Destinations. Book Sea View Villas B402 next door for even more space!
description_expanded: Description: Harp's Hideaway by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 4545 E County Highway 30A, Ste B401 Details: Welcome to Harp's Hideaway! Located in Seaview Villas, a gated Mediterranean-style complex along 30A in Seagrove Beach, this pet-friendly penthouse offers luxury, space, and comfort. Enjoy an open floor plan, gourmet kitchen, and an oversized balcony with pool and partial Gulf views. The master suite features a king bed, large vanity, soak tub, and walk-in shower, while two additional king bedrooms each have private baths. A bunk bed in the common area adds extra sleeping space. Amenities include a washer/dryer, elevator access, private beach trail, community pool, and nearby hiking trails. Explore Seaside, Rosemary Beach, and the area's top dining, including The Perfect Pig right next door. Your perfect coastal getaway awaits! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - *Pet Friendly With Approval. - Large Community Pool - Spacious Balcony - Private Beach Access and Private Beach - Wi-Fi - Centrally Located on 30A *Additional Pet Fee Applicable $350 each (pre-tax). *Please contact Reservations for approval prior to your stay. Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps 8 3.5 Bedrooms / 3 Baths One Floor: Bedroom 1 - King Primary Suite, Private Bath Bedroom 2 - King Suite, Private Bath Bedroom 3 - King Suite, Shared Bath Bunk Alcove - Twin/Twin Bunks Kitchen, Great Room, Dining Room, Balcony, Laundry Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -1 Beach Service Set* *Seasonal: March - October Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *For 6 bedrooms/6 full baths, also book Sea View Villas B402 next door. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
